review_type: Sequential editorial reading of the complete manuscript, organization review, applied revisions and rendered-PDF recheck.
reviewer_disclosure: Internal editorial assessment by the editing agent; prior mathematical/internal team audits are recorded separately. This reading pass is not external peer review.
verdict: Ready for submission from a natural reading-flow and organization standpoint, for a specialist review audience.
rating_interpretation: Subjective editorial judgments about reader experience, not an acceptance probability; novelty and mathematical originality scores are unchanged by these editorial revisions.

ratings.reason: The abstract and introduction establish the preservation question before the six-case inventory. The key term, audience and three reading questions are explicit.
Motivation leads to a concise method, overview table, paired cases, ordered examples and a three-part discussion. Technical repository/checker details are in end matter.
Transitions explain the move from probability laws to correlated averages, then analysis and algebraic data. Targeted example links connect detailed mechanisms to their simpler illustrations.
Short mathematical signposts identify the stages of each longer argument without introducing another numbered heading level.
The introduction puts purpose before background. Repeated conclusions and several defensive formulations are replaced by direct explanations. The technical middle remains appropriately demanding.
The Mahler calculation uses N for its complex dimension, distinct from the earlier convex-body dimension; the Crouzeix polynomial F and test polynomial G are introduced where used.
The discussion distinguishes comparative findings, practical use and scope. It ends with a concrete reading and formalization benefit instead of repeating all six cases again.
The overview remains on one page with clear row separation. Proposition statements stay with proofs; code stays with its introduction; the availability statement begins as a coherent block.

resolved_findings.revision: Rewrote the abstract and introduction around the mathematical question, defined preservation interfaces, and identified the intended reader.
Moved corpus counts, source pins and checking-infrastructure discussion to the data and code availability statement.
Moved the table into the case section before its first detailed case; removed the forced page break that left a large gap.
Added short mathematical paragraph headings within the six cases.
Added transitions explaining the three pairs of cases and the change in preservation requirement.
Added precise case-to-example references and a roadmap for the worked-example section.
Separated locality and named-coordinate examples, and ordered the nonprobabilistic examples to follow their cases.
Reorganized the discussion into findings, use in a new formalization, and scope/further work.
Separated the Mahler dimension notation and introduced the Crouzeix polynomial notation explicitly.
Kept proposition/proof blocks and code introductions together and protected the start of the availability statement.
Made the builder converge cross-references and the renderer remove only its own stale page images before counting pages.

retained_editorial_tradeoffs: The six cases retain technical detail so that the review explains actual mechanisms; specialist background is still needed for the analytic and structural arguments.
The three sampling examples form one connected composition, while the graph calculation and Crouzeix energy argument stay beside their source cases.
Evidence ledgers and full source anchors remain available without dominating the opening narrative.

preservation_checks.notation_change: N replaces n as the local complex dimension in the Mahler transgression calculation.

visual_review: All 23 final pages inspected through three contact sheets; full final pages 3, 16, 17 and 20 inspected for overview placement, code, propositions and end matter. No clipping, overlaps, missing glyphs or unresolved layout defects seen.
